product.schneider-t38625.summary: The 386 tower in the December 1991 German range.
product.schneider-t38625.history: Schneider placed the T386/25 in its tower range alongside the T486/33. The December 1991 German price list offered the machine with a 334 MB disk for DM 11,990 net.
product.schneider-t38625.technical.confi: The 334 MB disk identifies the advertised configuration. The table also lists 4 MB of RAM and a 1.44 MB floppy drive.
product.schneider-t38625.technical.verif: The offer is documented. A dedicated model and boot validation in BluMach remain pending.
product.schneider-t38625.technical.limit: The board still needs to be checked against a specimen and an attributed BIOS preserved. An image with clear publication rights remains pending.
product.schneider-t38625.technical.sourc: CC SELLER / BC, Schneider Computer, 12/1991, pp. 1–3
